title: New Tales from the Borderlands
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#961, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 2 of 5 after 3 minutes: the Epic copy. The title screen draws at about 30 fps on medium settings, but in game only the subtitles show over a black screen, at 60 fps. The logos at start stay black for about 35 seconds too, with their sound playing. The log has GStreamer's 'gst_video_info_from_caps: assertion gst_caps_is_fixed (caps) failed' three times. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#961 (2026-11-04): the game itself, not only its cutscenes, stays black with sound and subtitles. udance4ever again on highball-db#961 (2026-11-07), the Wine 11 engine r30, D3DMetal (Game Porting Toolkit 4.0 beta 3 by the Metal HUD): it plays. The intro video shows, the real-time cutscenes and the open world draw, at about 40 fps at 1920x1080 on a base M1 (GPU about 25 ms a frame). On the first launch the 2K logo crawled at about 4 fps, on the second it was fine. DXMT refuses it, the game is DirectX 12 only.
notes: Plays in one report on a base M1 with D3DMetal on the Wine 11 engine r30, the Epic copy, at about 40 fps at 1920x1080 (highball-db#961). On the default Wine 10 engine (r29) the logos and the game stay black with only sound and subtitles. An Unreal Engine game on Direct3D 12.

knownIssues.symptom: Black screen with only sound and subtitles, in the game itself as well as the logos and cutscenes (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.cause: most likely videos that don't decode. GStreamer's 'gst_caps_is_fixed' assertion is in the log three times, the same assertion Bloody Spell's videos hit (inferred, not checked with this game)
knownIssues.fix: move the environment to the Wine 11 engine r30 with D3DMetal, where the videos and the game draw (highball-db#961, 2026-11-07, credit udance4ever). DXMT doesn't run it, it's DirectX 12 only

knownIssues.symptom: On the first launch the 2K logo crawls at about 4 fps (M1, Wine 11 r30, D3DMetal)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed, most likely first-use work that later launches skip
knownIssues.fix: none needed, the next launch was fine
